meta.title: Custom Camp in the Caucasus | MKR Caucasian Camp
meta.description: Custom individual camp in the Caucasus. Wrestling in Dagestan, MMA in Chechnya or combo (custom only). Your dates, your duration. 90-day minimum lead time.

hero.label: CUSTOM · 1 TO 4 ADULTS
hero.title:
YOUR DATES.
YOUR JOURNEY.
hero.subtitle: Individual camp or small group of friends (1 to 4 adults). You choose your dates, your duration, and your destination(s): Wrestling in Dagestan, MMA in Chechnya, or a combo of both (custom only).
hero.image_alt: Solo MMA athlete in immersion in Makhachkala, custom MKR camp

cinematic.alt: Circle of fighters in a grappling demo in Dagestan
cinematic.label: WHO IT'S FOR
cinematic.title:
YOU CHOOSE WHEN TO LEAVE.
WE HANDLE THE REST.
cinematic.tagline: You have a clear goal and a specific window. We adapt the camp to your schedule, not the other way around.

combo.label: CUSTOM EXCLUSIVE
combo.title: COMBINE DAGESTAN AND CHECHNYA
combo.intro_suffix: . On the custom camp, you can combine both: part of the camp in Makhachkala for wrestling, another part in Grozny for MMA. The transfer logistics between the two regions are handled by MKR. Ideal for MMA athletes who want to sharpen their wrestling with the Dagestanis.

pro.title: Pro or semi-pro in camp
pro.desc: You're preparing for a fight or a tournament on a specific date. Custom lets you slot the camp right inside your prep window, with no compromise on the calendar.

planning.title: Athlete on a tight schedule
planning.desc: The official session dates don't fit (holidays, work, kids' school). You pick 1, 2 or 3 weeks at the time that works for you.

duo.title: Duo, trio or quartet of friends
duo.desc: You're 2 to 4 adults looking to leave together. You choose the dates, you live the camp as a small group without having to gather a full club.

steps.title: You fill out the form
steps.desc: Composition (1 to 4 adults), preferred dates (90 days min in advance), duration (1, 2 or 3 weeks), level, goals.

steps.title: MKR approval within 48h
steps.desc: We confirm coach and accommodation availability on your dates. Qualification video call.

steps.title: Approval and visa letter
steps.desc: You receive the official invitation letter for your Russian visa application and the bank details for full package payment by bank transfer.

steps.title: 6-week preparation
steps.desc: Remote physical prep program. Everything is settled, you just focus on training.

steps.title: Departure and camp
steps.desc: Domestic flight from Istanbul included (Makhachkala for Dagestan, Grozny for Chechnya). MKR vehicle at the airport. All you have to do is train.

sessions.label: OFFICIAL SESSIONS
sessions.title: 4 sessions per year
sessions.desc: Want to join a group put together by MKR? Four sessions timed with school holidays: Summer 2026, Toussaint 2026, Winter 2027, Easter 2027.

famille.label: FAMILY
famille.title: Family Camp
famille.desc: Going with a child 8-17? The Family funnel offers a parent and child program.

clubs.label: CLUB AND GROUP
clubs.title: Clubs and Groups
clubs.desc: Bringing 5+ people (club or organized group)? Dedicated camp, block accommodation.
